An '''unnamed chief scientist''' worked for the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was head of the project in developing the advanced [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defender]].

==Biography==
The chief scientist was the lead scientist of the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] project before [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]] betrayed the Empire and led his forces into an [[Zaarin insurrection|insurrection]]. Zaarin would then try to loot his [[Research]] facility, only to be thwarted by Loyalist Imperial forces led by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]. After his second [[Defense of Research|attempt]] to raid and capture the station failed, Zaarin led his [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroy]] ''[[Glory]]'' to [[Evacuation of Research|destroy]] the station. Loyalist forces managed to retrieve the remaining TIE Defender prototypes, [[Proto 11]] and [[Proto 12|12]] onto a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mharsup]]'' and the scientist onto a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[G'nabgib]]''.

The shuttle would rendezvous with 3 [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|modified corvette]] [[Hashim group|''Hashim'']] to place a TIE Defender in each corvette, with Maarek Stele's being in ''Hashim 3''. After [[Second battle of Parmel|fending]] off [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] forces trying to capture the prototypes, Hashim arrived to find itself in a [[Ambush on Hashim|trap]] laid by [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|Pirates]]. By the time Stele was launched to fight of the pirates, [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] [[Ibutho 1]] had already boarded the shuttle and kidnapped the scientist along with the data. Not long afterwards ''Proto 11'' was stolen by a [[Nami]] team while Stele was engaging Rebel raiders.

The Rneekii decided to [[Ransom/Legends|ransom]] the scientist to highest bidder, which was the Empire. Unfortunately, the pirates underestimated the Empire and after negotiating the ransom near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kiilimaar]], the Empire used Maarek Stele to outwit and [[Battle of Kiilimaar|trap]] the pirates with a [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor]] ''[[Red Claw]]''. After the scientist was on another shuttle, the code "Full Speed to Kiilimaar" was sounded and Stele engaged the pirates and the ''Red Claw'' arrived preventing their escape, when another Nami strike team disabled the shuttle and damaged the ''Red Claw'' disabling its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] and [[Gravity well projector/Legends|Gravity Well generators]] stranding both ships. The Nami tried to board the shuttle to capture the scientist but were unsuccessful his shuttle was repaired and brought to the ''Red Claw''. The Nami decided to inform Zaarin, who learn't that the ship was going to transfer the scientist and prisoners onto a Modified corvette called ''[[Chemeti 1]]'' so he sent an [[Chemeti's impostor|imposter]] ship to pick up the scientist, while sending a small attack force to distract the Imperials from noticing and gave him to the leader of the Nami [[Ali Tarrak]]. She used the scientist to help her create more TIE Defenders and decided to proliferate the ships, in particular to the Rebels.

Thrawn in response developed and deployed his latest project, the [[Missile Boat]] to police the proliferation and bring it under control. After finding Tarrak's [[Deep Space Manufacturing Facility]] [[Tarrak (Deep Space Manufacturing Facility)|''Tarrak'']] and [[Capture of Ali Tarrak|destroyed]] it, Ali Tarrak abandoned the factory in a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|transport]] ''[[Dhoora]]'' taking the scientist with her. When Stele attack the transport she warned to stay back or the scientist dies, but the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order of the Empire]] saw through her bluff and with the help of Stele, [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] disabled the transport and captured Ali Tarrak and the scientist as the ship was programmed to a course for [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==Behind the scenes==
The scientist is discussed in the [[1994]] PC game ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' and becomes a central plot of both the [[T/D Technology]] and [[New Threats]] battles. Throughout the game the scientist is usually referred to his title and his gender is only brought up once in Battle 10 Mission 1 by the [[Imperial briefing officer]].
